description: CTO continuation (evidence-backed, ungated): extend odg-evidence-pack licence-risk from npm-lockfile-only to ALSO cover composer.lock, whose packages carry a per-package `license` (SPDX array). Today buildEvidencePackMulti runs licenceRisk only on the npm source, so a composer repo gets 'licence not analyzed' despite the data being present — a documented limit (boussole), not an invented gap. Improve-before-add / reuse the existing risk shape; engine supply-chain-attest UNCHANGED; hermetic (no network).

authorization.authorization_source: CTO MASTER MANDATE continuation (§6/§9 — select the next evidence-backed transversal improvement; the npm-only licence limit is documented in the boussole).

work_item_contract.objective: Add licenceRiskComposer(content) (parse composer.lock packages+packages-dev, each p.license SPDX string|array ⇒ copyleft/unknown/licensed) and merge it into buildEvidencePackMulti's licence risk so analyzedEcosystems includes composer when present; honest note for ecosystems whose manifests carry no licence.
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: CLAIM: composer licence data is ignored. REPRODUCTION: buildEvidencePackMulti line ~161 only selects the npm source for licenceRisk; a composer-only repo ⇒ analyzedEcosystems=[] + note 'no npm lockfile'. ROOT CAUSE: licence extraction hard-bound to the npm packages-map shape. PLAN: add a composer licence extractor + merge; npm path + existing licenceRisk UNCHANGED.
work_item_contract.scope: odg-evidence-pack.ts only: one new extractor + a small merge in buildEvidencePackMulti + honest note. Engine UNCHANGED. Existing npm single-lockfile buildEvidencePack path UNCHANGED. No network.
invariants: Reuse the existing licence-risk shape {licensed,unknownCount,unknown,copyleftCount,copyleft}; no new primitive.
Fail-closed: malformed composer.lock ⇒ contributes nothing, never throws.
Honest reporting: analyzedEcosystems lists what was actually analyzed; note names present-but-not-analyzable ecosystems; never a false all-clear.
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic test: composer.lock with MIT + GPL-3.0 + no-licence ⇒ copyleft surfaced, unknown surfaced, licensed counted; npm+composer repo ⇒ analyzedEcosystems [npm,composer] + merged counts; composer-only repo ⇒ analyzedEcosystems [composer] (no false 'not analyzed'); malformed ⇒ fail-closed; npm-path non-regression (odg-evidence-pack.test.ts + polyglot + recursive ALL PASS); tsc 0; dist rebuilt + shipped bin over a composer repo shows licence analyzed; diff limited to write-set; committed.
stop_conditions: A change would require editing the engine / a path outside the write-set / a new primitive.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- runtime/bin/odg-evidence-pack.ts ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; rm -f src/runtime/evidence-pack-composer-licence.test.ts runtime/missions/COMPOSER_LICENCE_EXTRACTION.json; npm run build:runtime.

objectives.goal: Evidence-pack licence-risk covers composer.lock (copyleft/unknown/licensed) merged with npm; honest analyzedEcosystems/note; engine untouched; proven hermetic + shipped bin.
done_when: All acceptance_criteria met; committed in write-set.

definition_of_done: odg-evidence-pack analyzes composer.lock licences (merged with npm, honest coverage note), reusing the existing risk shape; engine unchanged; npm path unchanged; proven hermetic + shipped bin; committed (no force). General-capability improvement, NOT a client reference/certification.
